fixes.old: Don't do this if you've had too much of whatever chemicals you're using and feel overwhelmed, or if you're acutely confused, or otherwise not in a place where you can safely take care of yourself. Get the support you need in those situations, don't do exploratory hypnosis.
fixes.new: If you are overwhelmed by chemicals, acutely confused, or not able to keep yourself safe, then get some immediate support instead of doing exploratory hypnosis.
